provenance.descriptorKind: compatible outcome projection, not a runnable or original run manifest
limitations: Each exact journal is validated under its original declaration, schedule, registry and profile before semantic outcome selection; raw record and pair identities remain unchanged.
Original manifests and native preflight proofs were not supplied; reconstructed declarations do not attest to original engine binaries or native value tables.
No independent move replay, terminal-position certification, material fit, individual-piece Elo or population confidence interval is claimed.
The thirty-two fixed short prefixes remain related descriptive test cases. A target band is a design criterion, not demonstrated balance equivalence.

method.overall: Equal frozen-reference means over shared fully completed cases across all four references; draws count half a point.
method.cells: Each individual matchup retains all its complete color pairs, even when another opponent lacks that case.
method.baseline: Three two-step pawns are a separate equal-cost matchup, excluded from reference Overall; there is no baseline self matchup.
method.colors: Physical White/Black summaries use exactly the same shared reference cases and game count as Overall.
method.historicalReuse: 640 design-focus games plus 128 two-step-pawn reference games; no changed candidate reuses predecessor outcomes.
